title: Chlo's Minimal Armor
description: Makes armor not just minimal but more gender neutral. Also adds leather straps to give a more fantasy look ><0
body:
Adds a more fantasy minimal armor expirence ><0 ~. *

Copyright: You may modify for personal use only; otherwise **Credit Me**

- Its based upon the more popular minimal armor (with trims which i may or may not implement it depends)
- Its main goal is to keep minecraft's asthetic while being functional in combat (aka able to see what armor the enemy is wearing). While looking stylish when slaying enemies.
- Another goal being trying to make it more gender neutral since I dont like how it broadens shoulders. (main reason I made this in a day Im tired ><)
- It also pairs well with Wildfire's gender mod ><0 ~. *
- The pack should be viable for 1.20.1 and 1.21.11 as of 4/21/2026.


![Its the front of a player wearing the armor](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/55231bdd2fa98fd3ac4caea118c3082af8cd9054.png)
